correctness.rationale: The Rota–Baxter identity reduces exactly to n cyclic quadratic equations. A Jacobian computation isolates the zero operator for nonzero weight; localization at nonzero coefficients gives t(t^(2^n-1)-1)=0 with t-1 invertible. Chinese remainder and inseparable root multiplicities prove every scheme assertion. At zero weight, cyclic propagation classifies field points. Monomial rigidity of perfect evolution algebras gives the full automorphism action and Burnside gives conjugacy counts. Exact enumerations at 44 prime-field parameter cases plus three binary extensions corroborate equations and classes, with Jacobian rank checked at every listed prime-field point.
